fix: increase Prisma transaction timeout to 30 seconds

Resolves transaction timeout errors that were occurring during batch
congregation upserts. The default 5-second timeout was insufficient
for larger batches, causing retries and failures.

- Update both transaction calls in batchUpsertCongregations
- Set timeout to 30000ms (30 seconds)

refactor: migrate scrapers to GitHub Actions with Puppeteer for PCA

Move all denomination scrapers from Vercel serverless functions to GitHub
Actions to eliminate 30-second timeout constraints and enable headless
browser capabilities for Cloudflare bypass.

- Add Puppeteer dependency for headless browser scraping
- Refactor PCA scraper to use Puppeteer to bypass Cloudflare protection
- Create GitHub Actions workflow for daily scraper execution
- Add runner script (scripts/run-all-scrapers.js) for GitHub Actions
- Remove Vercel cron configuration and /api/cron/scrape endpoint
- Enhance fetchWithHeaders with User-Agent and additional headers

This resolves the PCA scraper Cloudflare blocking issue and provides a
more robust, scalable scraping infrastructure without timeout limitations.

fix: add postinstall script and cache Prisma client for Vercel

Add postinstall script to ensure Prisma Client is generated during
Vercel deployment. Cache Prisma client and connection pool instances
to prevent multiple database connections in serverless environment.

Changes:
- Add "postinstall": "prisma generate" to package.json scripts
- Implement singleton pattern for PrismaClient and pg.Pool
- Prevent connection pool duplication across serverless invocations

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
chore: add vercel to gitignore

fix: resolve Svelte 5 reactivity warnings by using $derived

Update all components to use $derived for computed values that depend
on props, fixing "state_referenced_locally" warnings. This ensures
proper reactivity in Svelte 5's new runes-based system.

Changes:
- Replace destructured prop assignments with $derived declarations
- Update Settings.svelte to use $effect for initialization
- Ensure all reactive computations properly track dependencies

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: migrate to Prisma 7 driver adapter pattern

Prisma 7 introduces breaking changes requiring migration from datasource
URL configuration to driver adapters. This commit updates the codebase to
be compatible with Prisma 7.3.0:

- Remove url and directUrl from schema.prisma datasource
- Install @prisma/adapter-pg and pg packages
- Update PrismaClient instantiation to use PrismaPg adapter with pool
- Regenerate Prisma client with new schema

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
